final: WITH units AS (SELECT tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist, AVG(sf.instownpct) AS ownership FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS sf JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON sf.transref = tr.transreg WHERE tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY tr.transreg, tr.ordertypedist), baselines AS (SELECT ordertypedist, AVG(ownership) AS mix_baseline FROM units GROUP BY ordertypedist), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ownership) AS overall_avg FROM units), kept AS (SELECT u.ownership, b.mix_baseline, o.overall_avg FROM units AS u JOIN baselines AS b ON u.ordertypedist = b.ordertypedist CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE u.ownership > o.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(ownership) AS avg_ownership, AVG(ownership / mix_baseline) AS avg_ratio_to_mix_baseline, AVG(ownership - overall_avg) AS avg_excess_overall FROM kept
